description: This Java class implements an 'And' logical criteria for filtering within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It combines multiple criteria into a single conjunctive criterion and supports visitor pattern for traversal.

classes.name: AndCriteriaImpl
classes.description: Implementation of a composite criteria that performs a logical AND over a list of sub-criteria.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to perform an operation based on the criteria, implementing the visitor pattern.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the list of criteria.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Computes a hash code based on the object and criteria list.
